name: larp
description: 🥝 For now, a programming learning app under development

paragraphs: A programming learning app built on the existing T3 Stack: Next.js App Router, TypeScript, tRPC, Drizzle, SQLite/libSQL, Clerk, Tailwind CSS v4, and coss/Base UI.
features: Five learning paths: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Next.js.

Ten complete lessons per path, fifty in total. Each includes a worked example, copyable snippet, guided explanation, starter code, a project-based exercise, progressive hints, server-side checks, and a recap. Each path…
A dashboard, course overviews, lesson workspace, freeform playground, garden, progress history, and settings.

Viewport-sized coding workspaces: tasks, code, and output sit side by side on desktop. Phones keep code and preview stacked together; instructions and hints open in a dialog. Individual panes scroll, so long code never…
Saved lesson drafts, exercise attempts, completion dates, daily intentions, and preferences. Unique completion is recorded only once per lesson.

whatItDoes.text: A programming learning app built on the existing T3 Stack: Next.js App Router, TypeScript, tRPC, Drizzle, SQLite/libSQL, Clerk, Tailwind CSS v4, and coss/Base UI.

requirements.text: The actual Clerk sign-up, sign-in, account, and sign-out UI will then be available.
It is not a simulated Clerk login.
